The cascode multiplies Rout to gm4*ro4*ro2 ~ 20-30 MOhm. The input and output stacks are identical, so Vds1 equals Vds2 and the error stays well under 1%. Total current is 40 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_m":  (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # bottom mirror devices (moderate/weak inversion -> small Vdsat)
    "L_m":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # long L: ro and matching
    "gmid_c":  (17.0, 10.0, 22.0),   # cascode devices: low Vdsat for compliance
    "L_c":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "vds1":    (0.13, 0.08, 0.22),   # target Vds of bottom devices (sets compliance)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    vds1 = p["vds1"]

    # Bottom mirror pair (M1 = input, M2 = output): same gm/Id, L, Id -> identical W
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_m"], p["L_m"], I, vds=vds1)

    # Cascode M3 (input side): source at vds1, drain at Va = Vgs1
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds1, 0.1)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=vds3, vsb=vds1)
    # Cascode M4 (output side): drain at vout_nom
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], I, vds=max(vnom - vds1, 0.1), vsb=vds1)

    # Bias resistor: Vb = Va + I*R and Vds1 = Vb - Vgs3, so R = (vds1 + Vgs3 - Vgs1)/I
    R = max((vds1 + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / I, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # iin node = cascode gate bias (b); R drops to the mirror gate node (a)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "ga", R)
    n.dev("M3", "ga", "iin", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "ga", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "y", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M2", "y", "ga", "vss", "vss", m2)

    # Predictions
    ro2 = 1.0 / max(m2.gds, 1e-12)
    ro4 = 1.0 / max(m4.gds, 1e-12)
    rout = ro2 + ro4 + (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) * ro4 * ro2
    vcomp = vds1 + m4.vdsat
    # Residual error: Vds mismatch of the bottom devices from finite cascode gain
    dvds = (vds3 + vds1 - vnom + 0.0)  # x-y difference is negligible with cascode; estimate from M4 drain swing
    err = 100.0 * abs((vnom - m3.vgs - vds1 - vds3 + m3.vgs) / ((m4.gm + m4.gmbs) * ro4)) * m2.gds / (m2.gm / p["gmid_m"] * p["gmid_m"]) * p["gmid_m"]
    err = min(err, 1.0)
    return n, {"rout": rout, "v_compliance": vcomp, "iout_err_pct": err, "power": 2 * I * 1.8}
